title: A rectifiable representation has Hⁿ-null carrier on each relatively compact open set where the current vanishes
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Eucl P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → IsOpen W → IsCompact (closure W) → closure W ⊆ U → T.VanishesOn W → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M ∩ W) = 0
